# NodeSight

When you track herbs or ore, the minimap just shows a dot for each one. You have to hover over every dot to see what it is. NodeSight puts the item's own picture on each dot so you don't have to.

## Features
* Square, round or gold ring pictures, in any size. A slider for the game's own dots too
* Red when your Herbalism or Mining is too low to gather it. Hover it and the tooltip says what it needs
* An arrow at the top of your screen pointing to the nearest one, with its name and how far away it is (off by default)
* Gold sparkles on the herb or ore in front of you. Change the color, area, height and how many (off by default)
* NEW Sparkles on the herb or ore you are facing, and on up to four more, from as far away as your minimap shows them (Beta, off by default: turn it on under Beta, with Sparkles on herbs or ore on)
* Sparkles on chests, doors, quest objects and anything else you can interact with (off by default)
* Switches between Find Herbs and Find Minerals by itself as you move, so you see herbs and ore on the minimap together. You need both Herbalism and Mining (off by default).
